audit_log_read.name: audit_log_read
audit_log_read.using:
"audit_log"."actor_id" = app.uid()
        or ("audit_log"."org_id" = app.org() and app.level() >= 30)
        or app.level() >= 50

budget_lines_via_budget.name: budget_lines_via_budget
budget_lines_via_budget.using: exists (select 1 from budgets b where b.id = "budget_lines"."budget_id")

budgets_via_proposal.name: budgets_via_proposal
budgets_via_proposal.using: exists (select 1 from proposals p where p.id = "budgets"."proposal_id")

generated.as:
setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(title, '')), 'A') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(subject, '')), 'B') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(description, '')), 'C')

notifications_org_insert.name: notifications_org_insert
notifications_org_insert.withCheck:
app.level() >= 30
        and exists (select 1 from users u where u.id = "notifications"."user_id" and u.org_id = app.org())

proposal_events_via_proposal.name: proposal_events_via_proposal
proposal_events_via_proposal.using: exists (select 1 from proposals p where p.id = "proposal_events"."proposal_id")

proposals_access.name: proposals_access
proposals_access.using:
"proposals"."owner_id" = app.uid()
        or ("proposals"."org_id" = app.org() and app.level() >= 30)
        or app.level() >= 50

team_members_insert.name: team_members_insert
team_members_insert.withCheck:
("team_members"."user_id" = app.uid()
          and exists (select 1 from teams tm where tm.id = "team_members"."team_id" and not tm.is_private))
        or exists (select 1 from teams tm where tm.id = "team_members"."team_id" and tm.owner_id = app.uid())
        or app.level() >= 50

team_members_update.name: team_members_update
team_members_update.using:
exists (select 1 from teams tm where tm.id = "team_members"."team_id" and tm.owner_id = app.uid())
        or app.level() >= 50

team_members_delete.name: team_members_delete
team_members_delete.using:
"team_members"."user_id" = app.uid()
        or exists (select 1 from teams tm where tm.id = "team_members"."team_id" and tm.owner_id = app.uid())
        or app.level() >= 50

teams_read.name: teams_read
teams_read.using: not "teams"."is_private" or "teams"."owner_id" = app.uid() or app.is_team_member("teams"."id") or app.level() >= 50

users_read.name: users_read
users_read.using:
"users"."id" = app.uid()
        or ("users"."org_id" = app.org() and app.level() >= 30)
        or ("users"."is_public_profile" and app.level() >= 20)
        or app.level() >= 50

users_update.name: users_update
users_update.using:
"users"."id" = app.uid()
        or ("users"."org_id" = app.org() and app.level() >= 40)
        or app.level() >= 50
users_update.withCheck:
"users"."id" = app.uid()
        or (("users"."org_id" = app.org() or "users"."org_id" is null) and app.level() >= 40)
        or app.level() >= 50
